import subprocess,os,signal,time,pathlib,requests
# identify exact app server commands only
out=subprocess.run(['ps','-eo','pid=,args='],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
pids=[]
for line in out.splitlines():
    parts=line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)
    if len(parts)==2 and parts[1] in ('node server.js','/usr/bin/node server.js'):
        pids.append(int(parts[0]))
print('exact old server pids',pids)
for pid in pids:
    try: os.kill(pid,signal.SIGTERM)
    except ProcessLookupError: pass
time.sleep(2)
p=subprocess.Popen(['node','server.js'],cwd='/app',stdout=open('/tmp/gearvault-clean.log','w'),stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=os.environ.copy()); pathlib.Path('/tmp/gearvault.pid').write_text(str(p.pid)); time.sleep(3)
print('clean pid',p.pid,'poll',p.poll()); print(pathlib.Path('/tmp/gearvault-clean.log').read_text()[-300:])
manager='33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333'; r=requests.get('http://localhost:3000/api/operations',headers={'X-Demo-User':manager},timeout=8); print('manager',r.status_code,'customers',len(r.json().get('customers',[])))
print('health',requests.get('http://localhost:3000/api/health',headers={'X-Demo-User':'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa'}).json())
